ui.voice_unavailable: Voice is not available for this language on your phone.
ui.wait: I will wait for the final list
ui.whatsapp_join: First, send the word “join <code>” to our WhatsApp number once.
status.wl: You are number {pos} in the [[wl:waiting line]]. Your ticket is not confirmed yet.
status.rac: You have a seat to sit, but you may have to share a [[berth:berth]] with one other person. It can get better if others cancel.
status.decide: The final list ([[chart:chart]]) is made around {time}. If you want a backup, look before then.
status.decide_est: The final list ([[chart:chart]]) is usually made 4–8 hours before the train leaves. Check IRCTC for the exact time.
alert.platform: Platform changed. Your train will now come to Platform {to}.
alert.delay: Your train is {min} minutes late. New departure: {time}.
alert.cancelled: Your train is cancelled. See other ways to travel. For e-tickets, IRCTC usually refunds automatically — check with IRCTC or 139.
alert.confirmed: Good news. Your ticket is now confirmed. Coach {coach}, berth {berth}.
trust.note: Always confirm with the official IRCTC app or 139. Last updated {ago}.
error.nodata: We could not get live information right now. Showing the last saved status.
error.badpnr: This PNR number does not look right. It should have 10 digits.
error.offline: You are offline. Showing the last saved status.
term.pnr.name: PNR
term.pnr.meaning: A 10-digit number on your ticket. It is how the railway finds your booking.
term.wl.name: WL (Waiting List)
term.wl.meaning: Waiting list. You do not have a seat yet. You move up when others cancel.
term.gnwl.name: GNWL (General Waiting List)
term.gnwl.meaning: General waiting list. The most common waiting list. It usually has the best chance to move.
term.rlwl.name: RLWL (Remote Location Waiting List)
term.rlwl.meaning: Remote location waiting list. Waiting list for stations in the middle of the route.
term.pqwl.name: PQWL (Pooled Quota Waiting List)
term.pqwl.meaning: Pooled quota waiting list. Waiting list for short-distance or intermediate-station travel.
term.rac.name: RAC (Reservation Against Cancellation)
term.rac.meaning: Reservation against cancellation. You have a seat to sit, but you may share a berth.
term.cnf.name: CNF (Confirmed)
term.cnf.meaning: Confirmed. You have your own dedicated seat or berth.
term.chart.name: Chart (Final List)
term.chart.meaning: The final passenger list. After it is made, your final status is decided.
term.berth.name: Berth
term.berth.meaning: The bed or seat you are assigned in a railway coach.
term.coach.name: Coach
term.coach.meaning: One railway carriage, like S4 or B2. Your coach is printed on the ticket.
term.class.name: Class
term.class.meaning: The type of coach: SL is sleeper, 3A/2A/1A are air-conditioned classes.
term.tatkal.name: Tatkal
term.tatkal.meaning: A quick-booking window opening one day before travel for urgent, last-minute tickets.
term.platform.name: Platform
term.platform.meaning: The raised track area where the train stops for passengers to board.
term.decideby.name: Decide-by Time
term.decideby.meaning: The recommended time by which you should arrange a backup travel plan.
